_comment: Chapter 5 of the story revamp (docs/gameplay/23 §4): the village square (hub_square): everyone home but the parents. S6 (docs/gameplay/23 §8): "How are things?" changes with the story (news_*: the latest chapter done).

text.zh_TW: 村子的廣場上，磨坊的水車又轉了起來。織布女在晾布，漁夫在補網，裁縫在幫大家改衣服——全村的人都在。
text.en: In the village square the mill wheel is turning again. The weaver hangs out cloth, the fisherman mends his nets, the tailor alters everyone's clothes. The whole village is here.

text.zh_TW: 磨坊主：「還差你爹娘。快去把他們帶回來，我們等著開慶功宴！」
text.en: Miller: "All but your parents. Hurry and bring them home. We're saving the feast for them!"

text.zh_TW: 磨坊主：「水車又轉了！織布女說，等你爹娘回來，要織一面新的村旗。」
text.en: Miller: "The mill wheel turns again! The weaver says that when your parents are home, she'll weave a new village banner."

text.zh_TW: 磨坊主：「新的村旗織好了——上面是一碗燉肉。是你娘選的。」
text.en: Miller: "The new banner is woven. There's a bowl of stew on it. Your mother chose it."
